author: Robin_DD_J
body:
Hello! I am happy to show of my first map ever!

Name: Lemniscate, I picked this name because there is this ∞ over the map. 
Amout of players: 20 vs 20
Type: This is a "Destory the monument" map. It's not suppose to be in the tm.
YML: http://pastebin.com/tSMXdeFY (Big thanks to Slicorn/iMercury)
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/?cgdux0v5jfklurj (Big thanks to Alex!)
Helpers: iMercury, Merlinmaster and Astronis
Random facts:
There is two secret chests on top of the lemniscate.
There are in total 8 sets of diamond armor for each team (24 dia blocks).
Easily unscape killfarming by going up the "lemniscate".

More pictures here: http://imgur.com/a/hUA0X

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Well, um, this map looks pretty much mysterious and I am exclusively intrigued by the shape of the infinity staircase, which is also pretty good looking by the way.
I cannot really imagine gameplay here but I can say it won't be bad, and that's it. Not saying it's gonna be good either, though. The flatness of the main terrain which is pretty much the area from the spawn and beyond until it reaches the front lines is, you know, flat, but the lemniscate kinda fixes it for the most part, except, of course, the front lines. I'd recommend and I think it would be absolutely fitting for this map to add these Rendezvous styled underground areas with iron bars and ladders, and the amount of void seems just a bit over the ideal size for this kinda map. I think it is good, pleasant to the eye and gameplay is interesting, but yeah what I said about it being flat can be easily fixed with the Rendezvous-styled underground things and void can be slightly reduced by a couple blocks only.
